title: PanKbase and DKNET Team Up to Empower Researchers with Data Mining Bootcamp
bodyHtml: Last month, the PanKbase team and DKNET hosted a bootcamp for the Sugar Science D challenge, teaching researchers how to mine datasets from PanKbase and Panc-DB. The full workshop is available to watch online for anyone interested in using these tools to advance their own research: Watch here.
summary: PanKbase team and DKNET hosted a bootcamp for the Sugar Science D challenge, teaching researchers how to mine datasets from PanKbase and Panc-DB.
